visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male server in a black chef uniform and face mask stands in a wood-paneled restaurant holding two black bowls, gesturing toward the camera. (2) Close-up shot of yellow ramen noodles being lifted with chopsticks from a dark-colored bowl filled with broth. (3) A large stainless steel pot on a stove boils with broth containing sliced onions, apples, tomatoes, corn, and green onions. (4) A top-down shot of a wooden tray containing a bowl of ramen, a soft-boiled egg, and side dishes. (5) Close-up of white seasoning powder being spooned into a bowl, followed by clear broth being poured in. (6) Noodle cooking baskets are shown being stirred and lifted in a professional boiler. (7) A white spoon lifts a clear broth from a bowl filled with noodles and sliced meats. (8) Chopsticks lift slices of grilled pork chashu and tender chicken from the ramen. (9) A small dish of red chili oil is poured onto the noodles. (10) A tray of side dishes is shown, including a halved soft-boiled egg with a runny yolk. (11) A bowl of eel rice is presented, topped with sliced eel, truffle paste, and green onions. (12) Grains of rice are mixed in a metal bowl while being seared with a blowtorch flame. (13) A black scoop places a dollop of truffle paste onto the eel rice. (14) Baskets of fries and fried appetizers lined with newspaper-style paper are shown. (15) An interior wide shot shows the warm, wooden restaurant setting with several customers seated at tables. (16) An exterior shot of the entrance features a white fabric sign with the name '荻沢' in black ink.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 不好意思哦. [Slogan]: 幫您加湯加麵. (2) [Subtitle]: 可以免費無限加湯加麵的拉麵店. (3) [Subtitle]: 自家熬煮高湯料理. (4) [Subtitle]: 喜歡清爽感可以試試柚子清香拉麵. (5) [Subtitle]: 特製文旦柚子粉加入高湯. (6) [Subtitle]: 搭配現煮拉麵. (7) [Subtitle]: 滋味甘醇帶點淡雅香氣. (8) [Subtitle]: 主食有豬叉燒、舒肥雞、星鰻. (9) [Subtitle]: 敢吃辣推薦加手炒辣醬. (10) [Subtitle]: 多了香辣感更好吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 另外還有附餐小菜和爆漿茶心蛋. (12) [Subtitle]: 想吃飯就來一碗炙燒松露星鰻飯. (13) [Subtitle]: 會拌入醬汁再炙燒. (14) [Subtitle]: 加上滿滿星鰻和松露醬. (15) [Subtitle]: 口感軟綿富含香氣. (16) [Subtitle]: 飯食會供應湯品. (17) [Subtitle]: 喝起來很暖胃. (18) [Subtitle]: 再加點一份松露脆薯. (19) [Subtitle]: 或是炸物滿足味蕾. (20) [Subtitle]: 喜歡吃拉麵就來這裡用餐吧. [Slogan]: 荻沢料理 私廚拉麵 高雄市左營區裕誠路209號. [Variety]: 請注意斜坡. (21) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (22) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
